The fix is to index properly. We can either:
1. Use `train_labels[i][0]` - get the first (and only) element of the 1-element array
2. Use `train_labels[i, 0]` - same thing using tuple indexing
3. Flatten the labels first

The simplest fix is to use `train_labels[i][0]` or `train_labels[i, 0]`.
